schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document lists Convict Creek (Region 6, Mono Co.) for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the "Put and Take" release program, with a release month range of April-November; the document is a provisional plan and CDFW notes execution is not guaranteed.
